Some info is shown in its original language.
A tiny little home on a Swakopmund small holding that plays host to wine, olives, chickens, vegetables, serenity and incredible desert views, minutes from town. Partly constructed with repurposed antique windows, you'll love the light entering this self-catering space, fully kitted for your escape.
